title: Chapter 1: Origin of the Universe
summary: Manu recounts the creation of the universe and the fundamental laws of nature.
ai_summary: The first chapter lays down the cosmological framework, describing how the unmanifest universe came into being through divine will.

verses.translation: The great sages approached Manu, who was seated with a focused mind, and having duly worshiped him, spoke these words.

layers.content: एकाग्रचित्त बैठे हुए मनु के पास महर्षियों ने आकर और न्यायपूर्वक उनकी पूजा करके यह वचन कहा।
एकाग्रचित्त बसलेल्या मनूजवळ महर्षींनी येऊन आणि त्यांची यथायोग्य पूजा करून हे वचन म्हटले.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The sages approaching Manu signifies the transmission of dharma from the supreme authority to humanity.
